required_training: RT-130, Wildland Fire Safety Training Annual Refresher (WFSTAR)
required_experience: Satisfactory performance as an Intermediate Faller ( FAL2 )
AND Completion and Certification of NWCG Task Book for the Position of Advanced Faller (FAL1), PMS 311-118 (see note)
other_training: S-211, Portable Pumps and Water Use
note: The use of the approved NWCG PTB for the FAL1 position is highly encouraged. However, agency-specific evaluation processes that document Completion and Certification of PTB can be used in lieu of the PTB if they meet or exceed the standard identified in the associated position task book.
